Assignment.description:
One target property and where its value comes from: exactly one of
`from` and `constant`.

constant.description: A constant value instead of a selector.

convert.description: The conversion applied to a read value.

from.description:
The selector read from the source root: dotted names or "quoted"
keys, each optionally filtered with `[key = "value"]`. A key that
holds a dot is quoted, for example `'"household.household_size"'`.
A quoted key or value takes any character except a control
character, a text-direction control or a line or paragraph separator;
`\"` and `\\` are its only escapes. Keys compare byte for
byte, with no Unicode normalisation.

target.description: The dotted path of the target property.

whenMissing.description: Whether an absent value fails or leaves the property out.

Conversion.description: The value conversion applied after a value is read.

oneOf.description: The value is copied as read.
An integer, or a string of digits, becomes an integer.
A string, or an integer, becomes a string.
A real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD` passes unchanged.

IngestionMode.description: How an ingestion mapping hands its item to the destination.

oneOf.description: A Proposal Action start input plus an empty submit body.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

MappingConstant.description:
A closed scalar constant. It is read by node kind (boolean, integer,
text) through a hand-written visitor, never a derived untagged union.

MappingHeader.description:
The mapping's identity, target, and generated-script location. Every path
resolves against the model file's directory.

entrypoint.description:
The generated entrypoint's Rhai identifier; it must not start with
`mapping_`.

script.description: A clean relative path to the generated Rhai script.

target.description: The kind of value the generated script produces.

targetSchema.description: A clean relative path to the target JSON Schema.

MappingTarget.description: What a mapping produces, which fixes the entrypoint signature.

oneOf.description:
A governed-ingestion item: `fn <entrypoint>_input(source)` plus the
`fn <entrypoint>(exchange)` wrapper.

WhenMissing.description: What happens when the source value is absent.

oneOf.description: The target property is left out; only for non-required targets.

mapping.description: What the mapping targets and where its generated script lives.
